findings.issue: Camera movement may alter board coordinates due to orbit constraints not guaranteeing orthographic stability
findings.impact: User may select wrong tile after zoom/rotate
findings.recommendation: Add explicit coordinate lock or recalc on camera change to maintain stable board coordinates

findings.anchor: Requirement: Combat effects and frame budget
findings.issue: Frame budget metrics rely on a single Mac reference; no cross-platform validation
findings.impact: Performance may exceed limits on other hardware
findings.recommendation: Specify minimum hardware or provide adaptive quality thresholds

findings.issue: `dispose()` calls `renderer.forceContextLoss()` after disposing resources, which may leave dangling GPU resources if called multiple times
findings.impact: Potential memory leak in long-running sessions
findings.recommendation: Guard against double disposal or remove redundant forceContextLoss

findings.issue: `motion.matches` is used to skip animations but not to cancel ongoing ones when preference changes mid-animation
findings.impact: Visual glitches if user toggles reduced motion
findings.recommendation: Add listener to `prefers-reduced-motion` media query and cancel current animation on change

findings.issue: Section 2 lists "Declined" for particle capacities but code still uses fixed counts; mismatch between spec and implementation
findings.recommendation: Update DRIFT.md to reflect current particle handling or adjust code to match spec
